description: This PHP class 'ConvertHex' provides methods to convert hexadecimal values to binary, decimal, and octal formats, including handling of negative numbers using two's complement notation. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine for engineering functions.

classes.name: ConvertHex
classes.description: A class for converting hexadecimal values to binary, decimal, and octal representations, with support for negative numbers and array inputs.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its binary representation, considering optional padding and handling negative numbers.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its decimal representation, handling two's complement for negatives.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its octal representation, with optional padding.

methods.name: validateHex
methods.description: Validates that the input string contains only valid hexadecimal characters.
